subject: Executive Approval Request: HelixAI Hosted API >20% Pricing Concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

Irene / Mina — quick background and ask up front: HelixAI (contact: Samir Shah) is at renewal for their Hosted API plan. They want a 12-month commit and are asking for a 28% off list rate for token usage (hosted API). This is outside standard delegation (>20%).

Why this matters:
- Current monthly spend today: ~$145k/month. Q2 usage shows a projected ramp to ~320k/month within 6 months if the pilot goes to prod.
- HelixAI is a strategic platform partner in our AI marketplace roadmap (we get co-marketing / reference asks).
- Risk if we decline: they will evaluate an open-source self-host path; high churn risk.

What I'm asking: Executive approval to grant a 28% concession on hosted API list rates for a 12-month commitment (deal HLX-2026-107). Terms proposed: 12-month term, net-30 invoicing, no change to data residency, usage-based billing with minimum monthly commitment of $100k.

Attached: HelixAI_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW), HelixAI_Q2_usage_breakdown.xlsx (usage + forecast).

If we approve, I'll finalize SOW and run Contracts through a standard counter-sign. If not, recommend a counter: 18% + a 60-day ramp credit instead.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

Thanks for the summary, Ben. A couple quick clarifying questions before I escalate:
1) Is the $100k minimum MMF baked into the SOW or a negotiation point?
2) What are the exact usage forecasts month-by-month (I see attachment but want the single-line delta vs current) — can you call out the revenue delta vs our target rate card?
3) Any precedent in last 12 months for >25% on Hosted for strategic partners? (I suspect very few).

If you can reply with the quick bullets and a short risk/mitigation summary, I'll take to Marcus for a yes/no.

Irene Choi
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

Irene — answers inline:
1) MMF: Proposed as part of the SOW (section 2.1). They signed the MOU verbally; the SOW includes a $100k minimum month commitment for 12 months.
2) Forecast: see quick table below (projected token-month billings at list price):
   - Current (avg last 3 months): $145k/month
   - Month 1-3 (post-sign): $160k/month
   - Month 4-6: $220k/month
   - Month 7-12: $320k/month
   Delta vs list (annualized) at 28% concession = ~ $1.1M revenue realized vs $1.5M at list (rough).
3) Precedent: In last 12 months only two instances >25% and both were multi-year Dedicated commitments with hardware guarantees. Hosted-only with >25% is effectively unprecedented.

Risk/mitigation:
- Risk: They test self-hosting → mitigate with a short-term SOW clause: if they drop below MMF for two consecutive months, we reserve right to revert pricing to list for remainder of term.
- Risk: Revenue erosion — mitigate by making concession conditional on a 12-month prepay option (they prefer net-30).

I've attached a markup (SOW highlights) and the usage spreadsheet (same attachments). If Marcus wants to accept but needs guardrails, suggest 28% with a 90-day review and an early-revert clause.

Ben
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

Marcus — FYI and recommendation: finance is OK to greenlight up to 30% on Hosted if the following conditions are included:
- $100k MMF (contractual)
- 60-day prepay option available for an additional 2% credit (Helix prefers net-30 but prepay reduces credit risk)
- Early-revert clause if usage falls >40% below forecast for two months
- Standard 30-day SLA credits only (no custom SLA)

If Marcus approves those terms, we'll ask Contracts to push final SOW with those guardrails.

Mina Haddad
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

All — I've reviewed. Approve the 28% Hosted API concession for HLX-2026-107 under these firm conditions:
1) $100k contractual MMF
2) Early-revert clause (usage drop triggers revert to list pricing) as Mina described
3) Add a 90-day business review with Sales + Finance to validate ramp; if Helix misses ramp, pricing rolls back and opportunity for a short-term remediation credit rather than ongoing concession
4) Require Contracts to include standard audit & usage reporting cadence (monthly) and one right-to-audit clause

Irene — please route to Contracts and reply-all to Samir with the approved terms. Keep me on the loop for SOW signature.

Marcus Lin
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@helixai.ai>, Contracts <contracts@helixai.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI renewal — ask for exec authorization >20% concession

Samir — good news. Marcus approved a 28% concession on Hosted API list pricing for the 12-month renewal under the conditions listed below (attached final SOW to follow). Key points:
- 12-month term, $100k minimum monthly commitment (contractual)
- Pricing concession: 28% off list for hosted API usage
- Early-revert clause if usage drops >40% below forecast for two consecutive months
- Monthly usage reporting; 90-day business review to validate ramp
- Net-30 remains acceptable; prepay option available for 2% additional credit if you want to move to prepay

I'll loop in Contracts to finalize SOW/term sheet. Expect redline within 24 hours.

Best,
Ben

--
Attachments referenced: HelixAI_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF stub), HelixAI_Q2_usage_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX stub)
